title: Rewards
purpose: The Trinity relationship and the Rewards-in-2027 decision. Rewards is the Customer's loyalty program: the Customer rewards residents for great behavior (pay on time, renew, refer), and Homebody fulfills the points, tracking, and redemption. Its economics are a Customer-side question.

sections.title: Why Trinity is frustrated
sections.body: From Chase's diagnosis recorded in the RXP Quarter Brief (2026-07-02): the driver is Rewards economics. Roughly $2k in points nets about $1k in redemption with no channel control, and the 'pay for Rewards, get apps free' deal anchor means frustration lands on the whole migration. Actual product issues (login, payments) were resolved within an hour each. The offering was then switched; adoption of the new offering is minimal (Cal, 2026-09-29).
